name: ʻOumuamua: a visitor from another star (2017)
description: The first object known to come from outside the solar system. It fell in steeply from above the planets' plane, swung round the Sun on 9 September 2017 inside Mercury's orbit, and left again on a hyperbola (eccentricity 1.2): it was moving too fast for the Sun ever to hold it, 26 km/s even far away. It passed the Earth at 0.16 au a month later. Elements at perihelion from JPL.
